name: 杨梅竹斜街
experience_value: Provides a slower old-city browsing segment where Beijing reads through shopfronts, lane rhythm, and everyday texture.
Useful near Qianmen when the route needs local grain rather than only big-axis symbolism.
Gives solo itineraries a place to observe and drift without needing a major ticketed attraction.
avoid_when: the route is designed as a clear first-visit highlight reel with little time for browsing
the traveler strongly dislikes slow retail-and-lane exploration
the day already contains multiple similar hutong browsing blocks
